message: Replace text input with textarea in ExecuteButton https://chat.openai.com/share/ac7beb37-586d-4b08-bd3b-f2f2eaeb408d

mention.mentioned_text: Replace text input with textarea in ExecuteButton https://chat.openai.com/share/ac7beb37-586d-4b08-bd3b-f2f2eaeb408d

code.before:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
goal="Implement clipboard reading fallback with input box"
echo "Plan:"
echo "1. Modify ExecuteButton.jsx to include a check for navigator.clipboard.readText availability."
echo "2. If unavailable, render an input box inside the button with placeholder."
echo "3. Execute the change when text is pasted into the input box."

cat > src/frontend/components/ExecuteButton.jsx << 'EOF'
import { createEffect, createSignal } from 'solid-js';
      {inputAvailable() ? (
        'Paste & Execute Change'
      ) : (
        <input
          type="text"
          class="w-full px-2 py-2 bg-white text-black"
          placeholder="Paste the change here to execute"
          value={changeInput()}
          onInput={(e) => setChangeInput(e.currentTarget.value)}

attention:
  - src/frontend/components/ExecuteButton.jsx
requirements: >
  When navigator.clipboard.readText is unavailable,

  then display an input box inside the button instead of the normal text.

  The placeholder of the input is: "Paste the change here to execute".

  When the user pastes a text into the input, execute it just like the pasted
  text at button click.
os: OSX
code.after:
attention:
  - src/frontend/components/ExecuteButton.jsx
requirements: >
  Use a textarea instead of the text input to prevent losing newline characters.
  Make it looking single-row.
os: OSX
